t: A Vehicle Card stores the blocks that make up a vehicle. The Vehicle Builder fills the card from a valid space chamber.
载具卡用于存储构成载具的所有方块。载具建造机将从有效的空间方块中读取并填充该卡片。
Insert the card in a Mover to place the vehicle at that node. The Mover Controller can then move the vehicle between connected Movers.
将卡片插入传运器，即可在该节点处部署载具。随后传运器控制器即可在已连接的传运器之间移动该载具。
